description: This file defines the AggInterval interface used for representing different interval types in data aggregation, including methods for interval calculations and validation.

classes.name: AggInterval
classes.description: Interface for different interval types used in data aggregation, with methods for retrieving interval properties and calculating interval boundaries.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the interval as AggIntervalType.

methods.name: getZoneId
methods.description: Returns the time zone associated with the interval.

methods.name: getCurrentIntervalDurationMillis
methods.description: Returns the duration of the current interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: getCurrentIntervalStartTs
methods.description: Returns the start timestamp of the current interval.

methods.name: getDateTimeIntervalStartTs
methods.description: Calculates the start timestamp of the interval for a given ZonedDateTime.

methods.name: getCurrentIntervalEndTs
methods.description: Returns the end timestamp of the current interval.

methods.name: getDateTimeIntervalEndTs
methods.description: Calculates the end timestamp of the interval for a given ZonedDateTime.

methods.name: getNextIntervalStart
methods.description: Calculates the start of the next interval based on the current start.
